text: These wireless networks work. Wireless networks are used in different environments, in different contexts, and for different applications. So, for example, we may have wireless networks that cover a large area, wireless networks that cover a local area like Wi-Fi, for example. We have fixed wireless internet access, satellite networks. Nowadays, they are becoming very, very important, and in general, wireless is used to replace cables whenever possible. And another very important area of application is to connect devices like sensors or the so-called Internet of Things, that are objects, things that we may need in our daily life or in smart factories or in storage places, many different environments where we have small devices that need to be connected to the internet. We do so by using wireless networks, and these different applications may need different, may have different requirements. So, for example, in some cases.
